constraints.constraint: The panda is lying down and resting instead of eating.
constraints.A_evidence: The panda sits upright, holding food against its mouth.
constraints.B_evidence: The panda reclines with its body stretched out and no food held to its mouth.

constraints.constraint: The panda rests its head on its paw.
constraints.A_evidence: Its head is upright, with a paw holding food near its mouth rather than supporting its head.
constraints.B_evidence: Its head is raised above its torso; neither paw supports its head.

constraints.constraint: The panda rests on a branch.
constraints.A_evidence: The panda sits on a broad cut tree stump rather than lying on a branch.
constraints.B_evidence: The panda reclines on the ground beside a tree trunk, with vegetation beneath its body.

judgment.reason: Neither panda rests its head on a paw while lying on a branch: A sits upright eating on a stump, and B reclines on the ground with its head raised.
